recap_text:
# HMPFL Week 1 Recap: Lockdown Begins

Cell doors slammed shut on Week 1, and let me tell you, some inmates came out swinging while others are already filing grievances with the warden. Welcome to another year in the yard, gentlemen.

## The Nail-Biter

In a shootout that came down to the final whistle, **Steve Ruggs** narrowly escaped **DUIiiiiiiii dont know jim** by the slimmest of margins, 245.15 to 243.75. That's a 1.4-point margin — basically a coin flip decided by a rounding error. Jim can appeal this to the parole board, but the final score is the final score. Sorry, pal, that's hard time.

## The Massacre

If you thought prison yards could get brutal, wait until you see what **Rice, Rice Baby ✨** did to **OJ's Denver Bronco**. A jaw-dropping 366.65 points obliterated OJ's respectable-on-any-other-week 177.35, for a margin of **189.3 points**. That's not a beatdown, that's a full-on riot with one side never even getting out of their cell. OJ, buddy, this one's going in the history books — and not in a good way.

Honorable mention to **Glove Don't Fit, Blitz**, who nearly matched that energy by dropping 320.95 on **The Massage Boys**, winning by 111.5. Two teams put up 320+ this week and somehow both were involved in blowouts of historic proportions. The warden might need to check these lineups for contraband.

## Standout Performances

The QB position went full warden-mode this week. **Josh Allen** torched the league for 73.0 points to power **System of a brown**, while **Caleb Williams** wasn't far behind with 72.9 for Rice, Rice Baby. Both signal-callers were basically running the yard like they own the place.

On the ground, **Kenneth Walker** (71.2) and **Derrick Henry** (69.1) proved that some inmates just don't wait for anyone — they bulldoze straight through the fence. Rookie **Ashton Jeanty** also flashed serious upside with 59.9 points, putting the league on notice early.

## Storylines to Watch

**Rice, Rice Baby ✨** didn't just win — they had THREE players in the top 10 performers (Williams, Swift, Watson) and still somehow only used a fraction of that damage to bury OJ. Book 'em, they're already the team to beat.

Meanwhile, **The ConVicks** and **The Massage Boys** are already looking at long sentences if they don't tighten up. Week 2, the yard awaits.
